target_customer: Teams building AI and coding agents who want better performance on long-horizon tasks
problem: Agents fail in repeated ways and hand-tuning prompts, context and models is slow; teams want automated optimization against their own task data.
business_model: Developer platform with free and paid tiers (a 2026 profile lists 20 and 200 dollars per month plans)
product_category: Agent optimization and reinforcement learning tooling

founders.name: Josh Purtell
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: Basis employee 3 and research scientist; published agent-optimization research at EMNLP.

competitors.name: DSPy (MIPROv2)
competitors.what: Open-source framework for automatic prompt and pipeline optimization
competitors.traction_then: Described as the 2024 compiler for multi-step pipelines

technical_complexity.rationale: Logging agent runs, finding failure modes and fine-tuning or reinforcement learning on small datasets is research-grade and relies on the founder's published optimization work.

defensibility.rationale: Optimizers such as DSPy and GEPA are open source, and model labs can offer fine-tuning directly, so the moat is research skill and execution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Synth; an unrelated Synth Labs and other Synth products exist.

market_need_then: Agent builders in 2024 faced unreliable performance and manual prompt tuning; the company reports a 33% relative gain on SWE-Bench for SWE-Agent with 100 training points (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses usesynth.ai with a use prefix, since synth.ai is not theirs.
branding.community_and_virality: Open-source synth-ai Python package with many releases; no merch or press about the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared by many unrelated Synth companies and products; no brand coverage found.

pivots.from: Automated training for vertical AI agents
pivots.to: Prompt and context optimization for coding agents, then managed research
pivots.why: YC launch post and later listings show different framing; reasons and dates not stated.

outcome_analysis: Synth is a one-founder research-led company from YC Fall 2024 that has reframed its offer from vertical agent training to coding-agent optimization and managed research. It still ships a product in 2026 per a profile. No verified funding or exit was found, so the outcome is undetermined and the key risk is open-source and lab-provided optimization.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator, another aggregator a 500K pre-seed dated December 2024; no press release. The company website fetch returned only the title 'Synth Swarms', so the site content was not usable. Team of 2 per YC though only one founder is listed. Pivots are inferred from differing YC launch and listing wording, undated. Completeness pass: the $500K of December 2024 is recorded from VCBacked (labelled pre-seed), a single database matching the YC standard amount. The $125K of 2021 belongs to a different company, Synth AI Labs.
